mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% in the current month predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to investor risk aversion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in at least 80% of similar inflation spikes (p-value < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS employment exceeds 5,000 jobs, accompanied by a simultaneous decline in UNRATE, signals labor market strengthening and supports positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >5,000 and UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under such labor conditions are not statistically superior to a baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 industrial production by at least 2% predicts negative S&P 5-day forward returns as it indicates weakening demand for capital goods.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases by ≥2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in >70% of such demand contractions (p-value < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO supply index below 100, combined with a rise in FEDFUNDS, suggests supply-side constraints and higher discounting, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS increases in the same month
regime_hint: supply shock in a tightening environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in 60% of such events (p-value ≥ 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-week decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate future rate cuts and equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under such conditions are not statistically higher than a no-rate-cut baseline (p-value ≥ 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden one-time monthly jump in HOUST housing starts exceeding the prior month's by 10% predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as it signals economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >10% relative to prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in 70% of such surges (p-value < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in RSAFS demand for Treasury securities exceeding 5% indicate a strong money demand, which is associated with negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns due to higher risk-free rates.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >5% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of such events (p-value ≥ 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A regime where UNRATE falls below 4% and INDPRO simultaneously declines by 3% suggests weak labor and supply conditions, predicting negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and INDPRO decreases by ≥3% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in 60% of such regimes (p-value ≥ 0.05).
